finding.summary: `shiftFormula`/`shiftSref` (row/column insert-delete, copy/paste) were never taught about unbounded REFERENCE tokens
finding.evidence: packages/sheets/src/index.ts exports `shiftSref`, `shiftFormula`, `shiftDimensionMap` (visible in the export list touched by this diff). These rewrite REFERENCE tokens of stored formulas when rows/columns are inserted or deleted and when formulas are copied. They are not in the changed-files list, yet the token shape they consume just widened to include `A:A`, `1:1`, `A1:B`. If they call `parseRef`/`parseRange` on each endpoint, an insert-row on a sheet containing `=SUM(A:A)` either throws mid-mutation or writes back a corrupted formula — persisted data loss. The site needing the fix is `shiftFormula`/`shiftSref` in packages/sheets/src/formula/ (pass through unbounded refs unchanged).
